why_this_check_came_FIRST: The mediator raised the archive coupling as a caution to accept rather than waive, and asked me to satisfy myself Gate 6's products are sound before archiving. GATE_5_BUDGET_IS_2x_HIGH_REDERIVED_FROM_.the_error: The Gate-5 predeclaration takes "one member is one full-event training: 6:00:36" from job 56563761. That job ran TWO sequential arms in one process -- the nominal and the matched floor -- so 6:00:36 is the cost of TWO trainings, not one.
GATE_5_BUDGET_IS_2x_HIGH_REDERIVED_FROM_.independent_confirmation_from_the_member: Gate 6 members are ONE training each: elapsed 03:02:38 / 03:05:15 / 02:59:03 / 03:00:38 / 02:59:23, mean 3.023 h, max 3.087 h. So one training is ~3 h and the predeclared figure is 1.99x high -- essentially exactly 2x, which is what a two-arm job divided by one would give.
GATE_5_BUDGET_IS_2x_HIGH_REDERIVED_FROM_.WHICH_FIGURE_TO_REQUEST_AGAINST: 154.4, the max-shape figure. Sizing an allocation on the MEAN is the max-shape error BEN-064 forbids -- a mean is not a bound, and five members is a small sample to take a maximum from either. Quote 154.4 and say it rests on n=5.
GATE_5_BUDGET_IS_2x_HIGH_REDERIVED_FROM_.does_not_change_the_architecture: Two jobs per replica is forced by ROOT-vs-TF interpreter exclusivity, not by cost, so halving the GPU estimate does not merge the legs. It does change what is worth requesting and possibly which queue.
GATE_5_BUDGET_IS_2x_HIGH_REDERIVED_FROM_.does_not_delay_anything: The bit-identity re-run is unaffected by the estimate.

AMENDED_20260813_MY_PREDICTION_WAS_FALSI.what_I_claimed: "Gate 6 needs no re-run on either declared BLOCK condition, so Gate 5 step 1 may archive the Gate-2 finals." The archive proceeded on that basis.
AMENDED_20260813_MY_PREDICTION_WAS_FALSI.what_happened: Gate 6 is BLOCKED by a THIRD control this receipt never examined: its predeclared member-trajectory control. 4 of 5 members FAIL. Only member 1 -- the promoted nominal's own seed policy -- passes. Member 3 fails `nonincreasing` while passing `final_at_most_0p10`, i.e. its deviation goes 0.0565 -> 0.0416 -> 0.0426, down then back up, so it fails monotonicity while satisfying the magnitude bar. Result: state/gate6-member-trajectories-result-56847059.json, array 56847059.
AMENDED_20260813_MY_PREDICTION_WAS_FALSI.so_the_prediction_is_false: I predicted Gate 6 would need no re-run. It is blocked and may well need one. `do_not_retry_unchanged` is binding, so any re-run requires a design change first, but "no re-run" is not what the evidence now says.
AMENDED_20260813_MY_PREDICTION_WAS_FALSI.WHY_THE_ARCHIVE_WAS_NEVERTHELESS_SAFE_AN: The Gate-2 re-run produced weights BIT-IDENTICAL to the archived ones -- sha256 544b2f6a..., same 18,723,004 bytes, and `cmp` byte-for-byte identical. So a Gate-6 re-run consuming the canonical path would consume a byte-identical array. The hazard I raised -- "after step 1 a Gate-6 re-run would consume the re-run's target" -- is NIL, because the two targets are the same bytes.
AMENDED_20260813_MY_PREDICTION_WAS_FALSI.the_honest_shape_of_this: My reasoning was incomplete: I checked the two BLOCK conditions the predeclaration NAMES and treated that as soundness, when a third predeclared control existed and was the one that failed. My conclusion was right, and it is right for a reason I did not rely on and could not have known at archive time, because bit-identity had not been measured yet. That is luck of outcome, not method -- the same shape as a published figure that happens not to be load-bearing.
AMENDED_20260813_MY_PREDICTION_WAS_FALSI.what_I_should_have_written: "Gate 6 is sound on the two BLOCK conditions the predeclaration names. I have NOT enumerated its other predeclared controls, so this is not a soundness verdict on Gate 6." That claim would have survived contact with the trajectory result.
AMENDED_20260813_MY_PREDICTION_WAS_FALSI.the_transferable_rule: Checking the conditions a document NAMES is not the same as checking the document. A predeclaration can carry controls outside its BLOCK list, and "sound on both BLOCK conditions" reads as "sound" to every later reader -- including the one who wrote it.
AMENDED_20260813_MY_PREDICTION_WAS_FALSI.not_adjudicated_here: That member 1 is the ONLY member passing, and is also the one whose seeds match the promoted nominal, is a substantive observation about whether the trajectory property is seed-specific rather than a property of the estimator. That is Gate 6's lane and its design decision, not this lane's, and it is noted rather than resolved.
